The '''Minister of War''' was a ministerial post in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during and after the [[Great Galactic War]] held by [[Shareis]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] was considered second only to the Minister of War.<ref name="Black Talon">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Black Talon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Minister of War has only been mentioned in the biography of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] on [http://www.swtor.com swtor.com] and in some instances in game. In one such instance, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] tells [[Cipher Nine]] that he has to rush to a meeting with [[Darth Baras]] and Minister of War to discuss possible [[Galactic War|renewal of hostilities]].<ref name="The Hidden Throne">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
